Exam Date & Time: 12-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  BIG DATA ANALYTICS [IT-4410]  
Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Discuss the life cycle of Big data analytics.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       An e-commerce company collects massive volumes of customer interaction data,  
  including browsing history, purchases, and reviews. The business team wants to improve  
  customer satisfaction and sales by identifying popular products, understanding product  
  performance issues, forecasting demand, and optimizing pricing and inventory. Apply     (5)  
  your understanding of the types of Big Data Analytics to this scenario. Demonstrate how  
  each type-when correctly applied-can help the company address its goals with suitable  
  justifications  
  
2)            A data analytics firm processes large datasets daily and stores them in an HDFS cluster  
  for distributed analysis. A data engineer uploads a 1GB log file to HDFS. During the  
  write operation, the file is divided into blocks and replicated across multiple nodes.  
  A)       However, midway through the upload, one of the DataNodes storing a block of the file (5)  
  crashes. Determine how HDFS ensures that the file is successfully written despite the  
  failure. In addition articulate the key steps involved in the write operation with diagram,  
  including how fault tolerance is maintained.  
  
  B)       Consider a collection of literature survey made by a researcher in the form of a text  
  document with respect to cloud and big data analytics. Analyze Using Hadoop and Map  
  Reduce, write a program to count the occurrence of pre dominant key words. Consider (5)  
  pre dominant words as Big Data, Hadoop, MapReduce  
  
3)            A logistics company is facing delays and inefficiencies with its current batch processing  
  system built on traditional MapReduce. To enable faster analytics and better system  
  performance, the company plans to migrate to Apache Spark. Apply your understanding  
  A)       of Apache Spark to propose a solution that improves system performance and                (5)  
  scalability. Consider how Spark's in-memory computation, multi-language support, fault  
  tolerance, and unified engine would benefit this logistics use case.  
  
  B)       A retail company wants to monitor user activity in real time by analyzing streaming  
  clickstream data from its e-commerce platform. Each data record includes user ID,  
  timestamp, and visited page URL. The company needs to compute the number of clicks  
  per page every minute and also keep a cumulative count of total clicks per page.     (5)  
  Apply your understanding of DStreams and Spark Streaming transformations to design a  
  solution that meets these requirements.  
  
4)            Determine the storage strategy followed with relevant examples of databases where         (5)  
  Riak and CouchDB applications are built upon

A)  
B) Correlate below SQL commands to its equivalent  
MongoDb commands  
a). UPDATE stud SET marks_dmsa = 50 WHERE class  
$$='TE';$$  
b). SELECT * FROM stud WHERE id =  
$$'5063114bd386d8fadbd6b004' AND Name = ‘Reena’ (5)$$  
$$AND Rno = 15;$$  
c) SELECT * FROM students WHERE course NOT IN  
(‘Math’, 'Science’);  
d) Select * from users order by name desc;  
e) select count(*) from stud where rollno=2;  
5) Describe Unsupervised and Reinforcement learning algorithms in detail.  
(5)  
A)  
B) Implement K Means algorithm using Pyspark assuming a suitable dataset. (5)  
-----End-----
